items.name: Veenendaal Open 2020
items.information:
De eerste 1,5 meter wedstrijd in Nederland! Let op: er is slechts een beperkt aantal plekken en er gelden aangepaste regels.  Maximaal 1 begeleider per deelnemer (van te voren aanmelden via het betaalformulier).
____
The first 1,5 meter competition in the Netherlands! Please note: there are only a limited number of spots available and there are modified rules. Max. 1 companion per competitor (register in advance via the payment form).

items.name: Sandnes Open 2020
items.information:
**English:**
Welcome to Sandnes Open 2020! The competition will use almost the same format as the Sandnes competitions from previous years, but this year there will be some fewer events.
The competition is free to attend for everyone - even for the competitiors. 

**Norsk:**
Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2020! Konkurransen vil ha ca samme format som de tidligere Sandnes-konkurransene, men i år er det noen færre grener.
Konkurransen er gratis for alle - også for deltakere.
